# zig-ctap2

> Portable CTAP2/FIDO2 USB HID library in Zig with a stable C ABI for native applications on macOS and Linux.

Published docs: https://transscendsurvival.org/zig-ctap2/. License: Zlib OR MIT.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-ctap2/blob/main/README.md): Overview, architecture, platform support, C and Zig API reference
- [Documentation](https://transscendsurvival.org/zig-ctap2/): MkDocs site
- [Apple interop](https://transscendsurvival.org/zig-ctap2/guides/apple-interop/): Swift/ObjC parity and gaps
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-ctap2/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Agent-oriented project summary
- [C Header](https://github.com/Jesssullivan/zig-ctap2/blob/main/include/ctap2.h): Full C API declarations

## API Overview

16 C FFI functions in `ctap2.h`:

- `ctap2_device_count` -- enumerate connected FIDO2 devices
- `ctap2_make_credential` -- register a credential and return raw CTAP2 response bytes
- `ctap2_get_assertion` -- authenticate and return raw CTAP2 response bytes
- `ctap2_get_info` -- query device capabilities
- `ctap2_make_credential_parsed` -- register and parse credential ID plus attestation object
- `ctap2_get_assertion_parsed` -- authenticate and parse credential ID, auth data, signature, and user handle
- `ctap2_parse_make_credential_response` -- parse raw MakeCredential response without HID I/O
- `ctap2_parse_get_assertion_response` -- parse raw GetAssertion response without HID I/O
- `ctap2_get_pin_retries` -- read remaining PIN retries
- `ctap2_get_pin_token` -- perform PIN protocol v2 token handshake
- `ctap2_make_credential_with_pin` -- PIN-authenticated registration
- `ctap2_get_assertion_with_pin` -- PIN-authenticated assertion
- `ctap2_make_credential_with_keepalive` -- registration with keepalive callback
- `ctap2_get_assertion_with_keepalive` -- assertion with keepalive callback
- `ctap2_status_message` -- map CTAP2 status byte to static message
- `ctap2_debug_last_ioreturn` -- return last macOS IOKit error code

## Platforms

- macOS: IOKit and CoreFoundation for USB HID
- Linux: hidraw

## Apple Interop Scope

zig-ctap2 implements external-authenticator CTAP2 over USB HID. Host applications remain responsible for AuthenticationServices/passkey UI, WebAuthn JSON, browser mediation, origin/RP policy, attestation policy, credential persistence, and UX.
